summary: Luckin Coffee filed a Form 6-K on September 29, 2026 attaching a press release announcing the appointment of Mr. Philip Yifei Bao to its board of directors, effective the same date, expanding the Board to ten directors, three of whom are independent. Mr. Bao serves as Director of Private Equity China at Mubadala Investment Company, Mubadala's China private equity arm. Chairman Hui Li welcomed the appointment, citing Bao's consumer-investing and China-market expertise. No stake, price, premium, advisor, or closing timeline was disclosed. This is a routine board appointment rather than a forced departure, so the special-situations signal is weak; watch for any subsequent Mubadala stake disclosure or board-level strategic influence.
